styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Anhui Museum, Bao Park and the old town lanes.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Lord Bao's temple, Li Hongzhang's former residence and the Three Kingdoms sites.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Swan Lake, Dashushan hill walks and Chao Lake day trips.

stays.why: Walk to Bao Park, the Anhui Museum and the main shopping streets. Best for first-time sightseeing.
Modern hotels around the lake and the Anhui TV tower. Quiet evenings, good for nature and views.
Handy for high-speed trains to Shanghai, Nanjing and Huangshan. Metro Line 1 reaches the centre.
Older station north of the centre. Cheapest beds and easy Line 1 access; area is busier and plainer.

food: Try Anhui cooking: braised pork, smoked and salted dishes, and bamboo shoots. It is savoury, not spicy.
Look for small local restaurants near Bao Park and the old lanes; menus are often Chinese only, so point or use a translation app.
Breakfast is cheap and local: steamed buns, congee and soy milk for a few yuan.
Night markets and food streets are best after dark; prices are low, roughly ¥10–40 a dish.
Big malls around Swan Lake and the centre have chain restaurants with picture menus if you want an easy first meal.
more_time: Add a day trip to Chao Lake, a large freshwater lake east of the city; check buses and timings on the day.
History fans can swap a city afternoon for the Three Kingdoms sites and Lord Bao's temple area.
Slow travellers can spend a morning walking Dashushan hill and an afternoon in the Anhui Museum.

recommend.why: One night covers the main sights; add a second night for a Chao Lake or Dashushan day out.

month_notes: Coldest month: highs near 8°C, lows near 0°C. Pack a warm coat.
Still cold, highs around 11°C. Few crowds at indoor sights.
Mild and warming, highs near 17°C. Good for walking.
Pleasant spring, highs around 22°C. Light layers are enough.
Warm and green, highs near 27°C. Good month for parks.
Warm start of summer, highs near 30°C. Carry water.
Hottest and wettest: highs near 32°C, about 16 rain days. Plan indoor time.
Hot and humid, highs near 32°C. Still about 12 rain days.
Cooling down, highs near 29°C. Comfortable again.
Best month: highs near 22°C, mild and dry-ish.
Cool and clear, highs near 17°C. Bring a jacket.
Cold, highs near 10°C, driest month with about 5 rain days.

climate_guide.summary: Humid subtropical: cold winters, hot humid summers, and the most rain in July. Spring and autumn are the best seasons.

items.title: Best time: April to May and September to October
items.text: Highs around 22–29°C with moderate rain. Ideal for parks, lakes and walking.

items.title: Hot, humid summer (June to August)
items.text: Highs near 30–32°C and lows near 21–25°C. Muggy nights; do outdoor sights early or late.

items.title: Wettest month is July
items.text: About 16 rain days. Keep an umbrella and a backup indoor plan.

items.title: Cold winter (December to February)
items.text: Highs of 8–11°C and lows near 0–1°C. Bring a warm coat; indoor heating can be limited.

items.title: Rain is spread through the year
items.text: Most months have 8–11 rain days. A small umbrella is worth packing any month.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light layers in spring and autumn, breathable clothes and sunscreen for summer, a warm coat for winter, and rain gear in July.

transit.best: Metro for most trips; taxis or Didi for short hops and late nights.

modes.text: Lines 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 cover the city. Line 1 links both main train stations.
Buses cost ¥1 non-air-conditioned or ¥2 air-conditioned. Routes are in Chinese only.
Green, blue and orange taxis start at ¥8; black taxis start at ¥9. Didi works well; have a Chinese number or Alipay set up.
Not advised for short visits; traffic and parking are stressful.
Fine around the centre and parks in mild months. Use metro or taxis for longer hops.
Mobike and Hellobike cost ¥1–2 per ride. Needs WeChat or Alipay.
